Arts

Unveiling the beauty of expression — from restoring a nation's paintings to backing today's artists.

Art tells a country who it is. We restored and showed 300 works from the Ksar Saïd collection, produced films and ran a prize for contemporary art — and today we back artists through open calls and residencies.

Selected projects

L'Éveil d'une Nation — عـهـد الأمــــان

An exhibition at the Palais Ksar Saïd, Tunis (from 27 Nov 2016), curated by Ridha Moumni: 300 artworks restored and shown to the Tunisian public, 45,000 visitors over three months and 300,000 more on social networks. Discover the exhibition

Rambourg Foundation Prize for Contemporary Art

Three editions, in 2017, 2019 and 2021. The best art projects were rewarded and funded by a senior, international jury.

Papa Hedi, The Man Behind The Microphone

A documentary directed by Claire Belhassine, granddaughter of Hedi Jouini, released in August 2017. The foundation also produced the short film Dido: First Queen of Carthage.

Calling Syrian Artists

An open call and residency for Syrian artists at Delfina Foundation, London, with Madad Art Foundation. Ranim AlHalaky was selected for the 2026 winter residency.

MARWAN: A Soul in Exile

Partner of Christie's 2025 summer exhibition in London: over 150 works by the Syrian artist Marwan (1934–2016).
